_note: Audience-state map. These are editorial hypotheses, not diagnoses. The engine uses them to choose a responsible movement, not to label a person.

overwhelmed_forecast.label: Overwhelmed by a predicted future
overwhelmed_forecast.movement: From fused with the forecast to curious about what the body is predicting.

certain_and_defensive.label: Certain and defended
certain_and_defensive.movement: From verdict to hypothesis; from explanation to honest uncertainty.
certain_and_defensive.safe_landing: Name one fact and one interpretation.

resentful_model.label: Locked inside a model of someone
resentful_model.movement: From mind-reading to evidence, checking and mercy.
resentful_model.safe_landing: Recall the exact words or action before the story about them.

grief_haunted.label: The past is furnishing the future
grief_haunted.movement: From the past as verdict to the past as material being used now.
grief_haunted.safe_landing: Notice the present room and what is actually here.

numb_familiar.label: The ordinary has gone invisible
numb_familiar.movement: From automatic recognition to renewed contact with the strange ordinary.
numb_familiar.safe_landing: Look closely at one familiar object.

different_inner_worlds.label: Assuming everyone experiences the same inner world
different_inner_worlds.movement: From projection to curiosity about cognitive difference.

powerless_waiting.label: Waiting while time crawls
powerless_waiting.movement: From passive dread to one chosen, proportionate action.
powerless_waiting.safe_landing: Choose one action small enough to do now.

spiritually_unmoored.label: Cosmic insight without a floor
spiritually_unmoored.movement: From metaphysical certainty to grounded wonder and evidence boundaries.

identity_locked.label: A label has become a prison
identity_locked.movement: From fixed identity to a useful story that can be revised.
identity_locked.safe_landing: Name what is happening now, not who you must permanently be.

body_boundary_uncertain.label: Questioning where the self begins and ends
body_boundary_uncertain.movement: From destabilization to curiosity about body ownership as an inference.

story_seamless.label: A smooth story feels like raw reality
story_seamless.movement: From seamless certainty to seeing the separate pieces that were stitched together.
story_seamless.safe_landing: List the observations before the connecting story.

belief_body_loop.label: Expectations are shaping bodily experience
belief_body_loop.movement: From magical control or helplessness to careful awareness of expectation effects.
belief_body_loop.safe_landing: Separate symptom, expectation and medical evidence.
